description: Baseline P0-P3 acceptance scan; existing migration snapshot ancestry check fails before implementation changes.

asi.hypothesis: Establish objective baseline before implementing roadmap gates.
asi.rollback_reason: Repository baseline contract suite has a migration snapshot ancestry mismatch unrelated to the new autoresearch harness.
asi.next_action_hint: Diagnose and repair the existing migration snapshot chain first so later improvements can be kept.

description: Reconciled order confirmation with ADR-0033 and repaired migration ancestry; process PostgreSQL tests exposed an accounting period date bug.

asi.hypothesis: Server-derived order lines and accounting profiles will close the ADR-0033 reconciliation gate.
asi.rollback_reason: Accounting period lookup still reports closed despite an open 2000-2099 period; changes reverted by experiment harness.
asi.next_action_hint: Fix utcDate: tests run with the Effect test clock at epoch, so posting date resolves to 1970-01-01. Use a provided current date/test clock or open period covering epoch in process tests, then reapply the captured ADR-0033 diff.
asi.learned: The production service uses Clock.Clock, and @effect/vitest supplies a test clock unless explicitly live; date-sensitive PostgreSQL tests must control/provide clock intentionally.

description: Align order confirmation with ADR-0033 and repair the migration snapshot ancestry chain.

asi.hypothesis: Server-derived order lines and accounting posting close the superseded workflow gap without broadening architecture.
asi.result: Process now reserves Sales-owned lines, derives revenue from order total, and no longer accepts client journal facts; tests and repository checks pass.
asi.test_clock_note: Date-sensitive @effect/vitest integration fixtures cover the epoch-based test clock explicitly.

description: Reconciled P0 and roadmap wording, but the current coarse metric already counted the conditional P0 readiness sentence.

asi.hypothesis: Explicit P0 closure and roadmap reconciliation would close an uncounted acceptance gate.
asi.rollback_reason: No primary metric improvement because the harness's P0 grep already treated 'P0 is READY only when...' as closure.
asi.next_action_hint: Bundle these documentation corrections with the next substantive P1 improvement, and later tighten the harness wording check without claiming a standalone gain.
asi.useful_changes: P0 explicit READY status; fiscal periods PARTIAL; process distinguished from Process Studio.
